mechanism_narrative: A Fed funds rate below 3% (indicating an accommodative monetary policy stance) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects a deteriorating economic outlook that has already been priced in by the market.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over the past month signals worsening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1050 thousand units signals weak consumer demand and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1050, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 (index, 2017=100) over the past month signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle recession (defined by unemployment rate above 5.5% and rising), the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the short term due to reduced consumer confidence and corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances in the late-cycle recession regime, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a stagflationary environment, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return signal fails to materialize in more than 60% of interaction-driven instances.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of early-stage recession (defined by housing starts below 1050 thousand units and unemployment rate above 5.0%) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to a confluence of weak consumer spending and labor market stress.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances in the early-stage recession regime, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (3-month moving average below 110) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO 3-month MA < 110, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
